verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is a first-party visual automation builder in which event triggers (e.g. a new deal being created) start sequences of automated blocks, including AI agents that enrich, score and route records without manual action. That covers the core of background, autonomous automation, but the evidence is mostly marketing pages plus SDK docs about building blocks, with little detail on how runs execute or are monitored. missing for 10: documented recurring or scheduled triggers, run history/monitoring and error handling for background runs, any independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Attio Workflows is a visual automation builder that lets workspace members define sequences of automated actions
Trigger when a new deal record is created.
When a new deal is created ... Web Agent Enrich the record with web research. ... Custom Agent Score the lead and route to the right AE.
A team of agents on every deal. Qualifying, enriching, researching, and moving to close.
Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal.
The handler runs once when a workflow that uses this trigger is enabled.
